01-sprint-brief.title: Sprint Brief
01-sprint-brief.purpose: Define the challenge, intended outcome, constraints, available evidence, and initial unknowns.

02-evidence-ledger.title: Evidence Ledger
02-evidence-ledger.purpose: Keep observed evidence, interpretations, assumptions, synthetic rehearsal, and unknowns visibly separate.

03-foundation.title: Foundation Hypothesis
03-foundation.purpose: State the target customer, problem, advantage, alternatives, differentiation, approach, and testable founding hypothesis.

04-journey-map.title: Journey and System Map
04-journey-map.purpose: Map the current journey, relevant actors, target moments, dependencies, and failure points.

05-sprint-questions.title: Sprint Questions
05-sprint-questions.purpose: Turn the long-term goal and riskiest assumptions into answerable sprint questions with signals and failure criteria.

06-solution-directions.title: Solution Directions
06-solution-directions.purpose: Present meaningfully different independently generated directions without hiding trade-offs or dissent.

07-decision.title: Direction Decision
07-decision.purpose: Record the human-selected direction, rationale, dissent, rejected alternatives, and unresolved risks.

08-experiment.title: Experiment Card
08-experiment.purpose: Define the hypothesis, test audience, scorecard, observable signals, and decision thresholds.

09-storyboard.title: Prototype Storyboard
09-storyboard.purpose: Specify the minimum sequence of realistic scenes required to test the selected hypothesis.

10-prototype-brief.title: Prototype / MVP Brief
10-prototype-brief.purpose: Choose the smallest test artifact that can answer the sprint questions and record its approved build, tool, safety, trial, deployment, and version boundaries.

10-test-plan.title: Customer Test Plan
10-test-plan.purpose: Define recruitment, consent, tasks, neutral interview prompts, evidence capture, and session logistics.

11-customer-evidence.title: Customer Evidence
11-customer-evidence.purpose: Present anonymised observed behaviour and quote/source pointers from isolated customer-session summaries before interpretation.

12-synthesis.title: Evidence Synthesis
12-synthesis.purpose: Compare structured customer-session summaries with sprint questions and show traceable patterns, contradictions, outliers, evidence strength, and gaps.

13-outcome.title: Sprint Outcome
13-outcome.purpose: Record the human's final outcome, supporting evidence, evidence strength, decision readiness, unresolved risks, owned next actions, and generated four-dimensional assessment.
